maria: :loudspeaker: Quick release-train heads-up — freeze window starts Mon 09:00 UTC. Please read the exception flow below; only critical fixes get exceptions. Short changelog is at the bottom.

jordan: Ack — is the freeze global across Hosted/Dedicated/Private?

maria: It is global for deploys touching serving runtime or core infra (routing, autoscaler, model registry). App-level config and docs updates can proceed but add a canary flag.

li: Can you clarify canary SLA during the freeze? We still need smoke tests for embeddings v2.

maria: Canary policy: allowed for low-risk canaries (no new kernels/quant changes). Canary windows are scheduled and gated by SLOs — if latency degrades >5% we abort. Post results in #eng-releases.

sanjay: If we need an exception for a hotfix (e.g., kernel panic), what's the fastest path?

maria: Exception process (fast path):
```
1) Create a short PR and tag release-lead.
2) Fill exception form: https://rdrw.in/release-exceptions (include risk, rollback plan, test checklist).
3) Ping @sre and @release-lead in #eng-releases. If approved, ops will schedule a manual push.
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window: Tue 2026-06-09 14:00-15:30 UTC for embed-pipeline-v2 on dedicated clusters. Reporter: @jordan.

jordan: Thanks — I'll attach the smoke test dashboard link after the run.

li: Re: embeddings v2 regression we saw last week: does this freeze block the rollback to embed-pipeline-v1?

maria: Rollbacks are allowed as exceptions if they reduce risk. File the exception form and mark as "rollback" — ops will prioritize.

sanjay: One more ops note: if you depend on autoscale policy tweaks, schedule them during the Friday slot (post-freeze) unless you have an SLO-based reason.

maria: Changelog (high-level):
- serving-runtime: kernel-selection tweak to reduce mem spikes (canary only).
- autoscaler: tuned cooldown to reduce thrash at low QPS.
- embed-pipeline: regression fix for tokenization edge-case.
- console: minor UX polish for rollout page.

maria: TL;DR — freeze Mon 09:00 UTC; exceptions by form + approval; canaries allowed with gates; tag me or @sre if urgent. :warning: :shipit:
